steps.title: Prepare equipment and reagents
steps.instruction: Select the Opentrons pipette model to be tested (P20 Single‑Channel, P20 8‑Channel, P300 Single‑Channel, or P300 8‑Channel) and the appropriate Checkit Go cartridge size (5 µL, 10 µL, 20 µL, or 50 µL). Use the red dye supplied with the Checkit Go device; if desired, red dye pellets may be used instead. Note that the protocol has only been validated with the supplied dye—other liquids require separate optimization. Contact Next Advance support for liquid‑compatibility questions and Opentrons support for protocol questions.

steps.title: Aspirate Checkit Go volume
steps.instruction: Pick up a fresh tip with the selected pipette and aspirate the Checkit Go‑specific volume from the cartridge reservoir.

steps.title: Dispense into cartridge well
steps.instruction: Dispense the entire aspirated volume into the first well of the cartridge, then discard the tip.

steps.title: Flip cartridge and record
steps.instruction: Promptly flip the cartridge as instructed by the software and record the measurement displayed for that well.

steps.title: Repeat for all wells
steps.instruction: Repeat the aspiration, dispense, and flip‑record sequence for each remaining well, starting each dispense in the next well, until all eight wells of the cartridge have been processed.

substeps.instruction: Pick up a new tip and aspirate the Checkit Go‑specific volume from the reservoir.
Dispense the volume into the next well (beginning with the first well on the first cycle) and discard the tip.
Flip the cartridge and record the measurement.
